content: Bor tuwan
Toi Mabude Nuhure hodde, "Tui edde tor fura gór ṭiya beggune zahazot golo, kiyollahoile ei halor manuš okkolor butore ãr sarme šude tore forhesgar lot faiyi.
Tottu fotti zator paki zanuwar okkolottu, zur milai, hãt zura gori, ar fotti zator napaki zanuwar okkolottu, zur milai, ek zura gori lowa foribo.
Ar asmanor faik okkolottu o hendilla gori, zur milai, hãt zura gori tor fũwati lowa foribo. Duniyait hitarar bongšo basai rakibolla hendilla goribi.
Kiyollahoile ar hãt din bade ãi duniyait sališ din sališ rait zór diyat rakium. Henot ãr sirištir hár zandar okkolore duniyaittu fũsi felaiyum."
Toi Mabude Nuhure hokum dilde mozin hibaye hár kissu goijje.
Duniyait fanir tuwan šuru oilde šomot Nuhur boyoš so šot bosor.
Fanir bottuwanottu uddar faibolla Nuhuye hibar bou, futain ar futaindor bouwain okkol loi zahazot góille.
Ar paki zanuwar okkolottu, napaki zanuwar okkolottu, faik okkolottu edde meṛit buke aṛede hár kissu,
zur zur Nuhur hãse aiyore zahazot góille, Allaye Nuhure hokum dilde mozin.
Ar he hãt din farai zaigoi bade duniyait tuwanor fani aišše.
Nuhur boyoš sošot bosor furaiyede he bosoror dui maš hõtoro dinor din, atikka meṛir tolottu beša beši fani uṛa šuru goijje, ar zóror fani zen asmanot faṛon doijje.
Sališ din sališ rait dori duniyair uwore zór forat roiye.
He din Nuh, Šem, Ham, Yafet name Nuhur futain okkol, edde hitarar fũwati Nuhur bou edde futor bouwain okkol zahazot góille.
Ar hitarar fũwati fotti zator ek ek zura gori fahari edde górwali zanuwar edde buke aṛede zandar, ar hár ḍoilla faik okkol o aššil.
Zibon niyaš loi basi roiyede hár zandar okkol zura zura Nuhur hãse zai zahazot goillil.
Hár zanuwar okkol, zandar ziniš okkol miyala edde morod mili zahazot uiṭṭe, ode ode Allaye Nuhure hokum dilde mozin. Toi Mabude zahazor dorozagan bon gori diye.
Bade sališ din mula duniyait maze tuwanor fani bariuṛat roiye. Tuwanor fani barizaiyore zahazsan meṛir uwottu fanit baši uiṭṭe.
Toi fani uiṭṭe edde duniyait beša beši fani bari giyegoi ar zahazsan fanir uwore baša šuru goijje.
Duiniyair uwore tuwanor fani eto beši uiṭṭe, hinor duwara asmanor nisor ḍõr ḍõr fahar okkolore beggunore ḍufaifelaiye.
Fahar okkol ḍufi bade o fani aro fundro hat uworor mikka uiṭṭe.
Henor zoriya duniyait solafira gorede hár zandar, faik, górot falede edde fahari zanuwar okkol, duniyait zãk bandi sorede šoṛo zandar okkol, ar hár manuš okkol mori giyegoi.
Fuwana zobinor uwore zibon niyaš loi basi aššilde zandar okkol beggun mori giyegoi.

Endilla gori hibaye zobinor bukor hár zandar fũsifelaiye, manuš, zanuwar, buke aṛede zandar okkol edde asmanor faik duniyaittu saf oigiyegoi. Šude Nuh edde hibare fũwati zara zahazot aššil hitara basi roiye.
Tuwanor faniye duniyai ek šo fõnzaš din ḍufi aššil.
